sealedRows.claim: Bells = fleet lanes. Rounds = rota ticks. A method = a fixed composition of stage-permutations. Ropesight (seed L45-L69): each ringer knows only their own next position (LOCAL rule), yet the band completes the method EXACTLY (GLOBAL correctness). L5: "The height is the only thing that has not changed in four hundred years" = the conserved cover (every bell rings every position the same count). L49: "no bell may move more than one place at a time" = every change is a product of disjoint adjacent transpositions. L57: conductor's calls = public broadcast, still local per lane. L21: "If the angle shifts by a degree, the stay cracks" = own-rope anomaly channel. The Tunnel (L123-137) = coordinated deviation: locally invisible.

sealedRows.R3c: DEVIATOR (unilateral wrong transposition at a chosen stroke; sealed before the sweep, tested exhaustively over ALL (stroke, bell, kind) samples on Minor and Doubles, kinds near-up/near-down/stay/far-up/far-down, both rules; vacuous samples — wrong transposition equals the right one or falls off the tower — skipped and counted): (i) P(clash at the deviation stroke) = 1 with an honest partner notified at the SAME stroke (detection latency 0): at the deviation stroke the honest bells claim exactly the positions that are NOT the deviator's method position, so ANY non-vacuous wrong claim lands in an occupied slot — the partition argument; (ii) OWN-ROPE (the lane's own expected-next-position check, L21) fires IFF |claim - own position| > 1 MEASURED — far kinds always (unless vacuous); stay kinds never (move 0); near kinds exactly when they compound a move into >= 2 places (count receipted — the corrected taxonomy); (iii) rule line: the stumble self-heals — every row after the deviation stroke is byte-equal to the method and the (doubled) course closes to rounds — full recovery from the lane's own count; (iv) rule method-pos: the lane cannot know its true place was lost and keeps ringing the method from where it IS — persistence, clash density and closure over a doubled course are BOOKED AS FINDINGS (no pass/fail); (v) lost-hunt (persists, hunts +-1 legally): own-rope NEVER fires after the start stroke (legal moves, wrong places), the course never returns to rounds, clash density receipted — detection is statistical (recurring clashes), not self-knowledge.
sealedRows.R3d: CONSPIRACY (The Tunnel, seed L123 "Neither end knew about the other."). Two lanes silently trade their planned claims for one stroke: the claim SET is unchanged. VERDICT PASS iff at the trade stroke, for EVERY sample (both methods, all pairs, both rules): zero clash, zero uninvolved-lane signal (no clash bit, no own-rope anomaly), and the rung row is a valid permutation but != the method row; AND rule line: the course heals byte-identically and closes (a one-stroke conspiracy is UNDETECTABLE by any local channel and by the rounds check — only the conductor's global audit or a chain replay sees it); rule method-pos: the pair cannot re-find its place, so post-trade disruption (clash density, closure over a doubled course) is BOOKED AS FINDINGS. Conspirator self-knowledge (own-rope inside the pair) is receipted, never counted as band detection.
